verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine. It offers one-shot chat, an OpenAI-compatible serve endpoint, and on-device desktop and mobile apps, so users can get AI-generated responses inside the product. Nothing in the evidence shows features for ingesting the user's own data or producing insights and suggestions from it; that would only work by pasting data into a generic chat. Missing for 10: ingesting or connecting to user data (files, documents, RAG), proactive insight or suggestion features, and any documentation or hands-on evidence of data-analysis workflows.
